messages:
Alex P: heads up — found inconsistent audit-log field names across docs and SDK snippets. some use `user_id`, others use `actor.id`. Also there's a dead link to the SDK example in the retention guide. Can someone take a pass on harmonizing? /cc @Riya S :eyes:

Morgan C: I can open a docs PR for the guide. Want me to switch everything to the new `actor` structure? :+1:

Riya S: yes, canonical shape is `actor.{id,type,display_name}` per runtime event schema. Need security signoff for wording around tenant isolation before we publish. I'll pull legal if needed.

Dave L: FYI the Python SDK example in the old snippet still uses `user_id`. I can update code and add a quick migration note. Link: https://staging.redwood/doc/retention#audit-examples (404 right now)

Alex P: thanks Dave. If you update the snippet, include a short note: "older SDKs may emit `user_id` — map to `actor.id` in ingestion". Keep the retention TTL wording unchanged.

Riya S: tagging @security-team (docs-bot) — can you confirm the recommended phrasing for "tenant separation"? We want clarity without promising architectural guarantees.

docs-bot: Security review requested for docs PR #789 — assigning to security oncall.

Morgan C: I'll draft PR: changes planned:
- harmonize examples to `actor` shape
- add migration note
- fix broken SDK link
- add tiny note about pseudonymization options

Morgan C: draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789

Dave L: pushed a branch with updated python snippet, leaving TODO for wording. snippet:
```
# old
event = {"user_id": "u-123", "action": "model.query"}
# new
event = {"actor": {"id": "u-123", "type": "user"}, "action": "model.query"}
```

Alex P: can you also add a one-line changelog entry under /docs/changelog/security.md ?

Riya S: I'll look at phrasing and do a quick pass tomorrow morning PST. If no red flags, merge after CI and staging preview.

Morgan C: great — assigning to Riya and Dave. I'll request review from legal if Riya thinks it's necessary. :handshake:

Alex P: thanks all. ping here when PR is ready and staging link works. :rocket:
